# Screens Together

> A local multi-screen display app for scrolling text and user-selected video on iPhone, iPad, native Mac, and Apple TV.

## Product facts

- iPhone/iPad can host or display; the host participates as a screen.
- A native Mac controller and its joined Display Node windows have separate roles; the controller is not a display tile.
- Prepare content and layout before creating an iPhone/iPad room. During playback, tap the display to reveal navigation and return to Host Room for pause or closure.
- Mac playback controls are in the controller window toolbar.
- Apple TV is a receiver and needs a nearby host.
- Local rooms need no account or cloud service. Allow local network discovery.
- This is selected-content tiling, not AirPlay, whole-desktop mirroring, or protected streaming playback.
- Shared-timeline coordination is not guaranteed hardware frame lock. Test the actual arrangement before an event.
- Store availability is determined by the App Store listing, not this file.
